annotations.title: Gas tracker, multichain gas: 5 EVM chains and Bitcoin fees

description: One call for current gas prices on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon: gas price, base fee and priority fee in gwei and what a plain transfer costs in the native coin and, for the ETH chains, in US dollars (Uniswap ETH price), sorted cheapest first, plus Bitcoin fee rates in sat/vB. Cheaper than the tools bought one by one. Use to pick the cheapest chain, time a transaction or show fees in a wallet. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=price,symbol); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result
